composition_rules: cover first: world chrome only above the Pulse Strip; install lives in Settings
home light: above the fold = chrome + Pulse Strip + top of Trend Panel
standing order: Pulse Strip -> alarm Insight pin -> Trend Panel -> Mix Donut + Journey Funnel -> Heat & Streaks + Health Gauge -> Faces Board -> Insight Feed
period is global: Today / 7d / 30d / All re-frames every block together
add-block: owners may add atoms and rearrange within the skeleton; no new visual design
honest sparse states: new apps render blocks empty with story-starts copy; fixtures posing as life = contract failure
identical skeleton in every app (Display Law 7)

blocks in every door: non-Dashboard doors compose a subset in the same relative order per door config, lead blocks promoted; simplicity law: surface = value + shape + micro-sentence, depth one tap away

hub_rollup.note: NayaNET's own team gauges (dock, queue, alignment) render through the same blocks

data_model.source: Nitro, The Living Data System, Part 4 (canonical)

disagreements_with_nitro.position: Health Gauge /100 = vitality (adopted); judgment scores (Calculator, scorecards) remain /10 on orbit-dial; scale declared in sub-line
disagreements_with_nitro.reason: one dial with two meanings corrupts both scales

disagreements_with_nitro.position: micro-sentence <=6 words on the Strip; full sentence + evidence + action in the Insight Feed
disagreements_with_nitro.reason: SN-0822 must ship, but Composition Law keeps home light and glanceable

disagreements_with_nitro.position: radar = Hub balance across dimensions (adopted as Hub-only); constellation instrument retained for connection-structure questions
native app tables = source zero (Nitro adopted over this lane's connector-first draft); connectors deepen the same metric IDs
disagreements_with_nitro.reason: works-right-away is only true if the block is born reading the app's own tables

nitro_part5: spectrum identity: blocks take spectrum colors in order, purple opens
motion is proof of life: count-ups, growth, sweeps, soft pulse on new data; reduced-motion = fully lit static, never broken
honest sparse states: blocks present and truly empty, never fixtures
period is one tap: Today / 7 days / 30 days / All, all blocks re-frame together
faces over rows, sentences over labels, journeys over totals
one system in every app: same blocks, same order logic, same grammar
display_laws.sn_0822: No naked numbers: every metric carries magnitude + shape + direction + a human sentence — or it doesn't ship

anatomy: sentence (plain words; correlation labeled as correlation)
insight_generation.suppression: dismissed card does not repeat within the same window

landing.what: Nu's flagship Reports build (Nitro's lane, in flight) — Pulse Strip + Trend Panel + Mix Donut + Insight Feed sentences first; Journey Funnel / Health Gauge / Heat & Streaks ride TEN-STAR-SCORECARD-2026-10-22 items 3-10
8 blocks minted as official Factory pieces in DESIGN-BLOCKS/blocks/graphs/ (named, dual-labeled); per-block exact-predicate Factory contracts written against Nu's proven prototype
every template ships the blocks as a standard feature; Hub rooms adopt them (Reports room first, Mirror B8); Hub rollup + balance-radar

flow: source zero: app's own Supabase tables instrument the universal core at build time
connect external source -> declared map resolves fields to metric IDs
added sources deepen the same blocks (extra rows/series); block shape never changes
create-a-world with native/manual metrics is a valid world
rules: unmapped source data is dropped, never guessed
zero mapped metrics = connect fails with honest error
contributions render SAMPLE until first successful sync
failed sync errors only its own contributions, with remedy
data older than 2x refresh interval shows exact age in gold in the sub-line

architecture.doctrine: One Universal App — Many Front Doors (Shawn, 2026-10-22, standing)
architecture.door_definition: entrance + main-page focus into the one interconnected app; a door config = cover + leading blocks + per-door data additions
architecture.dashboard_door: the door whose focus is the Living Data System itself
architecture.blocks_in_every_door: the 8 canonical blocks are a default property of the app in every door; door config declares which blocks lead; grammar/order/contracts never change between doors
architecture.simplicity_law: simplified-beautiful for an average person / child / grandma: simple in presentation, never shallow in substance; depth one tap away on every block
